whatsnew_change_music_stopped_following_.message: Music stopped following you between tabs Pressing Stop could start the music again in another tab about ten seconds later, and stopping the last ambient sound could move it somewhere else instead of ending it. Taking over playback from a second tab could also erase what you had just chosen to play. The way tabs agree on who is playing was rebuilt, and 21 tests now cover it.
whatsnew_change_music_stopped_following_.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_uploading_no_longer_stop.message: Uploading no longer stops the rotation Every upload used to pin itself, and a pinned wallpaper pauses the timer, so adding a picture quietly stopped your wallpapers from changing. An upload now shows straight away without being pinned, and the rotation carries on.
whatsnew_change_uploading_no_longer_stop.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_day_and_night_now_switch.message: Day and Night now switches in a tab you leave open The time of day was only checked when a tab opened, so a tab left open past 7 PM kept its daytime wallpaper. It now changes over on its own.
whatsnew_change_day_and_night_now_switch.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_a_dropped_file_that_is_h.message: A dropped file that is not a picture no longer empties the list Dragging in the wrong kind of file used to clear every wallpaper card until the next reload. It now just says the format is not supported.
whatsnew_change_a_dropped_file_that_is_h.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_the_weather_stopped_refe.message: The weather stopped refetching on every new tab It was ignoring its own cache, which quietly undid a fix from the previous release.
whatsnew_change_the_weather_stopped_refe.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_a_focus_session_could_co.message: A focus session could count twice With two tabs open, one Pomodoro could add two sessions to the day's count. The other tab now follows along instead of counting again, including when you start a timer somewhere else.
whatsnew_change_a_focus_session_could_co.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_the_wallpaper_list_is_qu.message: The wallpaper list is quieter Labels that repeated what the buttons already showed are gone, and nothing is written over the artwork any more. The file size and the duration appear when you point at a card.
whatsnew_change_the_wallpaper_list_is_qu.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_bookmarks_open_where_you.message: Bookmarks open where you tell them to Bookmarks have their own choice of opening in a new tab or the same one, separate from your shortcuts. Until you pick something there, they keep following the shortcut setting.
whatsnew_change_bookmarks_open_where_you.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.

whatsnew_change_smaller_fixes_a_saved_pl.message: Smaller fixes A saved playlist could appear twice in your library. Turning the clock off no longer hides the weather with it. Text colour and shadow now reach the Pomodoro labels. Ambient presets can go above 100 percent like the sliders always could. And anything that says Saved now checks that it really was. The clock and the greeting now fade with the rest of the page while you drag a wallpaper onto it.
whatsnew_change_smaller_fixes_a_saved_pl.description: In the list of smaller changes on the page that opens after an update.
